heading.en: Abinadi is protected by divine power—He teaches the Ten Commandments—Salvation does not come by the law of Moses alone—God Himself will make an atonement and redeem His people. About 148 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua puipuia Apinati i se mana paia—Ua aoao atu e ia Tulafono e Sefulu—E le na'o le tulafono a Mose e ala mai ai le faaolataga—O le a faia e le Atua lava Ia se togiola ma togiolaina Ona tagata. E tusa o le 148 T.L.M.

verses.en: And now when the king had heard these words, he said unto his priests: Away with this fellow, and slay him; for what have we to do with him, for he is mad.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ina ua uma ona faalogo mai le tupu i nei upu, sa fai atu o ia i ana faitaulaga: Aveese atu ia lenei tagata, ma fasioti ia te ia; ona o le a ea sa tatou mea e fai ia te ia, ona ua fasa o ia.

verses.en: And they stood forth and attempted to lay their hands on him; but he withstood them, and said unto them:
verses.sm: Ma sa latou tutū mai ma taumafai e faaoo o latou lima ia te ia; peitai sa tetee atu o ia ia te i latou, ma fai atu ia te i latou:

verses.en: Touch me not, for God shall smite you if ye lay your hands upon me, for I have not delivered the message which the Lord sent me to deliver; neither have I told you that which ye requested that I should tell; therefore, God will not suffer that I shall be destroyed at this time.
verses.sm: Aua tou te pa’i mai ia te a’u, ona o le a taia outou e le Atua pe a oo mai o outou lima ia te a’u, ona ou te le’i tuuina atu le savali na auina mai a’u e le Alii e tuu atu; pe ua ou ta’u atu foi le mea na outou talosaga mai ou te ta’u atu; o lea, o le a lē tuu ai e le Atua ia faaumatia a’u i le taimi nei.

verses.en: But I must fulfil the commandments wherewith God has commanded me; and because I have told you the truth ye are angry with me. And again, because I have spoken the word of God ye have judged me that I am mad.
verses.sm: Ae e ao ina ou faataunuuina poloaiga na poloaiina ai a’u e le Atua; ma ona ua ou ta’u atu ia te outou le upumoni, ua outou feita mai ia te a’u. O lenei foi, ona ua ou tautala atu le afioga a le Atua ua outou faamasino mai ia te a’u fai mai ua ou fasa.

verses.en: Now it came to pass after Abinadi had spoken these words that the people of king Noah durst not lay their hands on him, for the Spirit of the Lord was upon him; and his face shone with exceeding luster, even as Moses’ did while in  the mount of Sinai, while speaking with the Lord.
verses.sm: O lenei sa oo ina ua uma ona tautala atu e Apinati nei upu sa fefefe le nuu o le tupu o Noa e pa’i atu o latou lima ia te ia, ona sa i luga o ia le Agaga o le Alii; ma sa susulu ona fofoga i se malamalama tele, sa pei lava o fofoga o Mose a’o i ai i le mauga o Sinai, a’o fetautalatalaa’i ma le Alii.

verses.en: And he spake with power and authority from God; and he continued his words, saying:
verses.sm: Ma sa tautala atu o ia ma le mana ma le pule mai le Atua; ma sa faaauau atu pea e ia ana upu, e faapea:

verses.en: Ye see that ye have not power to slay me, therefore I finish my message. Yea, and I perceive that it cuts you to your hearts because I tell you the truth concerning your iniquities.
verses.sm: Ua outou vaai ua leai so outou mana e fasioti ai a’u, o lea o le a ou faauma atu ai la’u savali. Ioe, ma ua ou iloa ua tuia outou i o outou loto ona ua ou ta’u atu ia te outou le mea moni e uiga ia outou amioletonu.

verses.en: Yea, and my words fill you with wonder and amazement, and with anger.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma o a’u upu foi ua faatumuina ai outou i le ofo ma le meia, ma le ita.

verses.en: But I finish my message; and then it matters not whither I go, if it so be that I am saved.
verses.sm: Peitai ou te faauma atu la’u savali; ma o lea e lē afaina po o fea ou te alu i ai, pe afai e faapea ona faasaoina a’u.

verses.en: But this much I tell you, what you do with me, after this, shall be as a type and a shadow of things which are to come.
verses.sm: Ae o le tele lenei o mea ou te ta’u atu ia te outou, o le mea tou te faia ia te a’u, pe a uma atu lenei, o le a avea o se faatusa ma se ata o mea o le a oo mai.

verses.en: And now I read unto you the remainder of the commandments of God, for I perceive that they are not written in your hearts; I perceive that ye have studied and taught iniquity the most part of your lives.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ou te faitau atu ia te outou poloaiga a le Atua o totoe, ona ua ou iloa ua lē o tusia i latou i o outou loto; ua ou iloa foi sa outou suesue ma a’oa’o atu le amioletonu i le vaega tele o o outou olaga.

verses.en: And now, ye remember that I said unto you: Thou shall not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of things which are in heaven above, or which are in the earth beneath, or which are in the water under the earth.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, tou te manatua sa ou fai atu ia te outou: Aua e te fai mo oe se tupua ua ta, po o se faatusa o mea o i le lagi i lugā, po o mea o i le lalolagi o i lalo, po o mea o i vai o i lalo o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And again: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them; for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquities of the fathers upon the children, unto the third and fourth generations of them that hate me;
verses.sm: Ma lea foi: Aua e te ifo oe lava i ai, aua foi e te auauna i ai; auā o A’u o le Alii lou Atua, o se Atua fuā, e asiasi atu i amioletonu a tamā i luga o fanau, i tupulaga e tolu ma le fa o i latou o e inoino mai ia te a’u;

verses.en: And showing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
verses.sm: Ma faaali atu le alofa mutimutivale i afe o i latou o ē e alolofa mai ia te a’u ma tausi i a’u poloaiga.

verses.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.sm: Aua e te ta’u fua le suafa o le Alii lou Atua; ona o le a ta’usalaina e le Alii o ia o lē na te ta’u fua lona suafa.

w.en: Thou shalt not take in vain

verses.en: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.sm: Ia manatua le aso sapati, ia tausi lona paia.

verses.en: Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work;
verses.sm: O aso e ono e te galue ai, ma fai ai au galuega uma lava;

verses.en: But the seventh day, the sabbath of the Lord thy God, thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy man– servant, nor thy maid– servant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates;
verses.sm: Ae o le aso fitu, o le sapati o le Alii lou Atua, aua e te fai ai se galuega, o oe, po o lou atalii, po o lou afafine, o lau auauna-tane, po o lau auauna-fafine, po o au manu, po o le tagata ese o i totonu o ou faitotoa;

verses.en: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is; wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
verses.sm: Ona o aso e ono na faia ai e le Alii le lagi ma le lalolagi, ma le sami, ma mea uma lava o i ai; o le mea lea na faamanuia ai e le Alii le aso sapati, ma faapaia i ai.

verses.en: Honor thy father and thy mother, that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
verses.sm: Ia e ava i lou tamā ma lou tinā, ina ia faalevalevaina ou aso i luga o le laueleele ua foaiina mai e le Alii lou Atua ia te oe.

verses.en: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.sm: Aua e te fasioti tagata.

verses.en: Thou shalt not commit adultery. Thou shalt not steal.
verses.sm: Aua e te mulilua. Aua e te gaoi.

verses.en: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbor.
verses.sm: Aua e te molimau pepelo i lē lua te tuaoi.

w.en: Thou shalt not bear false witness

verses.en: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbor’s wife, nor his man– servant, nor his maid– servant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor anything that is thy neighbor’s.
verses.sm: Aua e te manao i le fale o lē lua te tuaoi, aua e te manao i le avā a lē lua te tuaoi, po o lana auauna tane, po o lana auauna fafine, po o lana povi, po o lana asini, po o soo se mea lava a lē lua te tuaoi.

verses.en: And it came to pass that after Abinadi had made an end of these sayings that he said unto them: Have ye taught this people that they should observe to do all these things for to keep these commandments?
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona faai’u e Apinati o ia upu sa fai atu ai o ia ia te i latou: Pe ua outou a’oa’o atu ea lenei nuu e tatau ona latou tausiusi i le faia o nei mea uma ina ia tausia nei poloaiga?

verses.en: I say unto you, Nay; for if ye had, the Lord would not have caused me to come forth and to prophesy evil concerning this people.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu ia te outou, E leai; auā a na outou faia, po ua lē faia e le Alii ou te sau ma vavalo atu le leaga e uiga i lenei nuu.

verses.en: And now ye have said that salvation cometh by the law of Moses. I say unto you that it is expedient that ye should keep the law of Moses as yet; but I say unto you, that the time shall come when it shall no more be expedient to keep the law of Moses.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ua outou fai mai e ala mai le faaolataga i le tulafono a Mose. Ou te fai atu ia te outou e tatau ona outou tausia pea le tulafono a Mose mo le taimi nei; ae ou te fai atu ia te outou, e oo mai le taimi o le a lē toe tatau ai ona tausia o le tulafono a Mose.

w.en: when shall no more be expedient

verses.en: And moreover, I say unto you, that salvation doth not come by the law alone; and were it not for the atonement, which God himself shall make for the sins and iniquities of his people, that they must unavoidably perish, notwithstanding the law of Moses.
verses.sm: Ma e lē gata i lea, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e lē ala mai le faaolataga i le na’o le tulafono; ma a na leai le togiola, lea o le a faia e le Atua lava ia mo agasala ma amioletonu a ona tagata, e lē ma’alofia lava le tatau ai ona fano i latou, e ui i le tulafono a Mose.

verses.en: And now I say unto you that it was expedient that there should be a law given to the children of Israel, yea, even a very strict law; for they were a stiffnecked people, quick to do iniquity, and slow to remember the Lord their God;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ou te fai atu ia te outou sa tatau ona i ai se tulafono e tuuina mai i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ioe, o se tulafono patino lava; ona o i latou o se nuu sa ua maaa, sa vave ona latou faia o le amioletonu, ma gese ona latou manatua o le Alii lo latou Atua;

verses.en: Therefore there was a law given them, yea, a law of performances and of ordinances, a law which they were to observe strictly from day to day, to keep them in remembrance of God and their duty towards him.
verses.sm: O lea sa i ai se tulafono sa tuuina mai ia te i latou, ioe, o se tulafono o tu ma sauniga, o se tulafono sa tatau ona latou tausiusi tonu i ai mai lea aso i lea aso, e taofi ai i latou i le manatua o le Atua ma lo latou tiute ia te ia.

verses.en: But behold, I say unto you, that all these things were types of things to come.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o nei mea uma o ni faatusa o mea o le a oo mai.

verses.en: And now, did they understand the law? I say unto you, Nay, they did not all understand the law; and this because of the hardness of their hearts; for they understood not that there could not any man be saved except it were through the redemption of God.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, pe sa latou malamalama ea i le tulafono? Ou te fai atu ia te outou, E leai, sa latou lē malamalama uma i le tulafono; ma o lenei ona o le maaa o o latou loto; ona sa latou lē malamalama e lē mafai ona faaolaina o soo se tagata vagana e ala i le togiola a le Atua.

verses.en: For behold, did not Moses prophesy unto them concerning the coming of the Messiah, and that God should redeem his people? Yea, and even all the prophets who have prophesied ever since the world began—have they not spoken more or less concerning these things?
verses.sm: Auā faauta, sa le’i vavalo atu ea Mose ia te i latou e uiga i le afio mai o le Mesia, ma o le a togiola e le Atua ona tagata? Ioe, ma e oo i perofeta uma o e sa vavalo talu mai le amataga o le lalolagi— sa latou le’i tautatala ea i se tulaga e uiga i nei mea?

verses.en: Have they not said that God himself should come down among the children of men, and take upon him the form of man, and go forth in mighty power upon the face of the earth?
verses.sm: Latou te lei fai mai ea o le a afio ifo le Atua lava ia i totonu o le fanauga a tagata, ma ave i ona luga foliga o le tagata, ma afio atu i le mana tele i luga o le fogaeleele?

w.en: upon the face of the earth?

verses.en: Yea, and have they not said also that he should bring to pass the resurrection of the dead, and that he, himself, should be oppressed and afflicted?
verses.sm: Ioe, ma latou te le’i fai mai foi o le a faataunuuina e ia le toetutū mai o e ua oti, ma o ia, o ia lava, o le a sauaina ma faapuapuagatiaina?

w.en: and have they not said also
that he should bring to pass
